title: Straight-line optimality in Bellman's lost-in-a-forest problem for Euclidean balls
summary: We prove that among all unit-speed paths, a straight line minimises the expected escape time from a ball in $\mathbf{R}^n$, solving the min-mean variant of Bellman's Lost~in~a~Forest problem for ball-shaped forests. The proof uses the Kneser--Poulsen conjecture in the plane, together with results on polygonal chain straightening in higher dimensions. Moreover, we calculate this minimal escape time by deriving the expected linear distance to the boundary of a ball in $n$ dimensions.
